text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past interactions as broad interest in related products or content, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose of the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they preserve a specific connection in musical style, narrative tone, repair task, or equipment use.",
    "Complementary supplies and accessories appeal when they support an established activity or add a useful capability to existing equipment."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with stronger matches despite serving different tasks, listening preferences, or viewing interests.",
    "Device ownership is treated as demand for similar devices even when their functions are already covered.",
    "Older or occasional interests receive weight beyond their relevance to the user's recent activity."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, ecosystem, era, and surface similarity substitute for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "Past interaction is treated as continuing demand without enough distinction between complementary purchases, replacements, and duplicate capabilities."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent, repeated activity provides a more specific indication of current intent than isolated historical interactions.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, material, content format, tone, and musical style determine whether an otherwise related item is useful.",
    "Users distinguish general interest from immediate choice and often want only the strongest match among substitutes."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items too often share a broad association with the history without satisfying the specific purpose, fit, or added value that would motivate a choice now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose for a concrete connection to recent or repeated activity.",
    "The frequency of rejection because of duplicate functionality, incompatible requirements, unrelated tasks, or mismatched content style and format.",
    "The frequency with which users prefer a specific match over more highly ranked broadly related alternatives.",
    "The share of recommendations users cannot assess because item identity or content is unavailable, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
